sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We value our cooperation and would like to reach an agreement that works for both sides.

Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 4.39 (po:4500014467-10, po:4500014389-10, po:4500014329-10).
Our forecast for this part is up 4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09).
Your on-time delivery was 85.0% in 2026Q3 (sc:70620@2026Q3).

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.77 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24 months.

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
That does not change our position.
We can accommodate your request for a 24-month contract and 90-day payment terms, offering a revised price of €4.94 per unit.
As a distributor, our pricing reflects current market conditions and procurement expenses, which prevents us from sharing a detailed cost breakdown.
We believe this proposal accurately reflects the value and reliability we provide under these extended terms.
Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months.
A few words on this from our side.
We have carefully reviewed your proposal, but we are unable to reduce our price below €4.94 for the requested 90-day payment terms and 24-month contract.
As we have reached the limit of what we can provide under these conditions, please consider this our final offer.
Our conditions follow our Preisliste and discount tiers.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
